rules.one_source: This is the editorial and pricing source of truth. Page-specific hardcoded pricing must be migrated and checked against these records.
rules.public_pricing: Only offers with status existing_public have already-listed price figures. Verify final scope/terms before migrating page copy.
rules.new_offers: Proposed offers must show 'Request a scope' or 'Custom quote', not invented dollar figures.
rules.hosting: Client retains control of domain and business accounts. Platform fees, support coverage, backups, change requests, and incident SLAs must be spelled out in each signed scope.
rules.data: Report reviews require customer-supplied existing reports or authorized data access. No invented financial savings or guaranteed outcomes.
rules.email: Newsletter signup needs separate subscriber storage, affirmative consent, unsubscribe, and actual send pipeline. Never send subscribers to the sales-lead endpoint.
rules.protected: Do not change api/lead.js or any lead-backend locked components without explicit UNLOCK LEAD BACKEND instruction.

website_service_terms.billing: One-time build prices; 50% deposit / 50% before launch unless a written agreement states otherwise.
website_service_terms.scope: One website, one approved scope. Revisions are consolidated review rounds, not unlimited requests.
website_service_terms.client_assets: Client supplies approved text, logos, photos, and legal language. Copywriting, photography, asset sourcing, and licenses quoted separately.
website_service_terms.extra_page: Additional standard page from $200 using an existing approved layout and client-supplied content. New custom page layouts from $350; subject to quote.
website_service_terms.care_extras: Out-of-scope work $100/hour in 30-minute increments with written approval; standalone changes minimum $75.
website_service_terms.care_billing: Monthly in advance; 30 days notice for cancellation; existing customer contracts not automatically changed.
website_service_terms.ownership: Client owns deliverable website files and original content according to project contract. Domain and third-party accounts should be client-controlled.
website_service_terms.unsupported: Custom apps, booking inventory, authentication, database recovery, payment gateways, and integrations require separately scoped care.
website_service_terms.backups: Static-site source/redeploy recovery is different from database/upload backups. Never promise backup coverage without a tested restore process.
website_service_terms.fees: Payment processing, domain renewal, email, paid APIs, third-party licenses, and overage usage are separate.
website_service_terms.response: Response time means acknowledgement during standard business days, not guaranteed completion.
website_service_terms.changes: Final prices and terms require owner approval before public release.

care_billing_replaces.note: Do not silently modify existing agreements or the public site until approved.
